description: Kubeconfig security audit — Offline security audit of a Kubernetes kubeconfig (text= YAML or JSON, or url=). Checks insecure-skip-tls-verify, plain-HTTP / legacy 8080 API servers, public-IP endpoints, CA and client-cert expiry, client certs in system:masters (unrevocable cluster-admin, parsed from the X.509 subject), long-lived certs, embedded private keys, static and non-expiring service-account tokens (JWT decoded locally), basic auth, deprecated gcp/azure auth-providers with inline refresh tokens, exec plugins (v1alpha1, untrusted paths, remote scripts, inline secrets in env/args), broken contexts and a production default context. Secrets are never echoed; you may replace token values with REDACTED. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, score, grade, shareable flag, per-cluster/user summary and findings with fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
- name: dev
  cluster:
    server: https://203.0.113.10:6443
    insecure-skip-tls-verify: true
users:
- name: ci
  user:
    token: REDACTED
contexts:
- name: dev
  context:
    cluster: dev
    user: ci
current-context: dev

name: security_kubeconfig_check
